definition_title: Rational place indices and residue characteristics — 有理处指标与剩余特征 — 有理素点の添字と剰余標数
natural_language_statement:
**Formal-code readback**

**English**

RationalPlace is an inductive type with no field parameters or typeclass hypotheses. Its elements have exactly two forms: finite(p), for a prime natural number p, and a single additional element infinite. The parameter p belongs to Nat.Primes, the subtype {p ∈ ℕ | p is prime}; thus p ≥ 2, and neither 0 nor 1 is permitted as a finite label. Different prime values give different finite elements, and every finite element is distinct from infinite. Primality witnesses do not give additional distinct elements over the same natural number. An equality decision instance is derived for this type.

The predicate IsFinite : RationalPlace → Prop is defined by IsFinite(finite(p)) = True for every prime p, and IsFinite(infinite) = False. The function residueChar : RationalPlace → ℕ is defined by residueChar(finite(p)) = p, using the underlying natural number of the prime subtype, and residueChar(infinite) = 0. In particular, 0 is the value for the infinite element, while every finite element has a prime value at least 2; there is no element with residueChar equal to 1. These are definitions on an abstract tagged type. This packet does not construct absolute values of ℚ, residue fields, or an identification with another place type.

**简体中文**

RationalPlace 是一个归纳类型，没有域参数或类型类假设。元素恰有两种形式：对每个素自然数 p，有元素 finite(p)；此外还有唯一一个元素 infinite。参数 p 属于 Nat.Primes，即子类型 {p ∈ ℕ | p 为素数}。因此 p ≥ 2，有限分支不允许以 0 或 1 为标签。不同素数值给出不同的有限元素，每个有限元素都与 infinite 不同。同一自然数的不同素性证明不会给出额外的不同元素。该类型通过派生得到可判定的相等关系实例。

谓词 IsFinite : RationalPlace → Prop 定义为：对每个素数 p，IsFinite(finite(p)) 为真；IsFinite(infinite) 为假。函数 residueChar : RationalPlace → ℕ 定义为：residueChar(finite(p)) = p，其中取素数子类型的底层自然数；residueChar(infinite) = 0。因此，0 是无穷元素的函数值，每个有限元素的函数值都是不小于 2 的素数；不存在 residueChar 值为 1 的元素。这些定义作用于抽象的带标记类型。本代码包没有构造 ℚ 上的绝对值、剩余域，或该类型与其他位类型的对应。

**日本語**

RationalPlace は体を引数とせず、型クラスによる仮定も持たない帰納型である。その要素には二つの形だけがある。各素数 p に対する finite(p) と、唯一の追加要素 infinite である。p は Nat.Primes、すなわち部分型 {p ∈ ℕ | p は素数} の要素である。したがって p ≥ 2 であり、有限側の標識には 0 も 1 も使用できない。異なる素数値は異なる有限要素を与え、すべての有限要素は infinite と異なる。同じ自然数の素数性の証明が異なっても、別の要素にはならない。この型には等号の決定可能性のインスタンスが導出される。

述語 IsFinite : RationalPlace → Prop は、各素数 p に対して IsFinite(finite(p)) が真、IsFinite(infinite) が偽となるように定義される。関数 residueChar : RationalPlace → ℕ は、residueChar(finite(p)) = p、residueChar(infinite) = 0 と定義される。前者では素数の部分型から基礎となる自然数を取り出す。したがって無限要素の値は 0 であり、有限要素の値はすべて 2 以上の素数である。residueChar が 1 となる要素は存在しない。これらは抽象的な標識付きの型に対する定義である。このコードには ℚ の絶対値や剰余体の構成、あるいは別の素点の型との同一視は含まれない。

**Paper source context (English; separate from the formal-code readback)**

**Paper source context.** Mochizuki III, Introduction (p. 11), calls $\mathbb V_{\mathbb Q}$ the set of valuations of $\mathbb Q$. The following passage constructs one local tensor product for each $v_{\mathbb Q}$ by first summing over chosen places above $v_{\mathbb Q}$ and then tensoring over the labels. The opening of §3 repeats $\mathbb V_{\mathbb Q}\overset{\mathrm{def}}{=}\mathbb V(\mathbb Q)$ (p. 92). Mochizuki I, §0, p. 35, supplies the general place terminology.

**Implementation scope.** The local RationalPlace type represents this index by one constructor for each rational prime and a separate infinity constructor. Its IsFinite predicate tests the constructor. Its residueChar function returns the prime on a finite label and returns $0$ at infinity by an explicit implementation convention. The definition does not itself construct absolute values or prove equivalence with Mathlib’s places of $\mathbb Q$. The direct paper location for this index is III, pp. 11 and 92; I, Definition 3.1(e), provides broader initial-data background.

Shinichi Mochizuki, *Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory III: Canonical Splittings of the Log-theta-lattice* (May 2020), Introduction, sentence defining the rational valuation index; printed/PDF page(s) 11.

> Write $\mathbb V_{\mathbb Q}$ for the set of valuations of $\mathbb Q$.

Transcription: visually checked; line breaks and typography are normalized as recorded in the source evidence.

Shinichi Mochizuki, *Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory III: Canonical Splittings of the Log-theta-lattice* (May 2020), Introduction, construction paragraph and both bullets, ending with the name tensor packet; printed/PDF page(s) 11.

> Then, in order to obtain objects that are immune to the various label indeterminacies discussed above, we consider, for each element $*\in\mathbb S_{j+1}^{\pm}$, and for each [say, for simplicity, nonarchimedean] $v_{\mathbb Q}\in\mathbb V_{\mathbb Q}$,
>
> - the direct sum of the log-shells associated to the prime-strip labeled by the given element $*\in\mathbb S_{j+1}^{\pm}$ at the $\underline v\in\underline{\mathbb V}$ that lie over $v_{\mathbb Q}$;
>
> we then form
>
> - the tensor product, over the elements $*\in\mathbb S_{j+1}^{\pm}$, of these direct sums.
>
> This collection of tensor products associated to $v_{\mathbb Q}\in\mathbb V_{\mathbb Q}$ will be referred to as the tensor packet associated to the collection of prime-strips indexed by elements of $\mathbb S_{j+1}^{\pm}$.

Transcription: visually checked; line breaks and typography are normalized as recorded in the source evidence.

**Actual consumer.** RationalPlace indexes the local packet data and LogVolumeData.globalVol. The graph proceeds through LocalEstimate.rhs_le to theorem110. This indexing retains the separate rational-place contributions used when IV, Theorem 1.10, proof Step (viii), sums local upper bounds (p. 30); the carrier does not prove those bounds.

These Definitions are detached source preparation; the consumer paths describe the original reference graph and do not establish live mission-root membership or S2-04 completion.

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Defs

set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

namespace AbcAdaptation.Reference

/-!
# Rational places (taxis #43)

The index set `V_Q = V(ℚ)` of rational places used by the large volume container of the
Corollary 3.12 variant (taxis #33): one nonarchimedean place for each rational prime `p`,
and the unique archimedean place `∞`.

The container of taxis #43 keeps its data indexed by `v_Q ∈ V_Q` throughout — the
`v_Q`-level direct-sum decomposition of the tensor-packets must not be collapsed — so
this small module fixes the indexing type once and for all.

## Source correspondence

`V_Q := V(ℚ)` as in IUT I, Definition 3.1(e), and the `v_Q`-indexed tensor-packets of
IUT III, Propositions 3.1–3.3.
-/

namespace Iut

/-- A place of `ℚ`: either the nonarchimedean place attached to a rational prime `p`,
or the archimedean place `∞`. This is the index set `V_Q` of the `v_Q`-indexed local
tensor-packets of IUT III, Propositions 3.1–3.3. -/
inductive RationalPlace : Type
  /-- The nonarchimedean place of `ℚ` attached to the rational prime `p`. -/
  | finite (p : Nat.Primes) : RationalPlace
  /-- The archimedean place of `ℚ`. -/
  | infinite : RationalPlace
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace RationalPlace

/-- A rational place is nonarchimedean if it is attached to a rational prime. -/
def IsFinite : RationalPlace → Prop
  | finite _ => True
  | infinite => False

/-- The residue characteristic of a nonarchimedean rational place, and (by the junk
convention, documented here) `0` at the archimedean place. -/
def residueChar : RationalPlace → ℕ
  | finite p => p
  | infinite => 0

end RationalPlace

end Iut

end AbcAdaptation.Reference
